_doc: Single source of truth for the Boxabl clip style. If PRESET.md and this file disagree, this file wins.

band._doc: the source video sits in a 4:3 band over a blurred, darkened copy of itself

title._doc: bottom-aligned 40 px above the band; *word* = accent colour; \n = line break; <= 22 chars a line

caption._doc: centred below the band; active word in the accent colour; chunk breaks at 3 words, a >0.6 s gap, . ? ! or a cut

tag._doc: small boxed label, e.g. KITCHEN • BATHROOM • BEDROOM; needs pos [x, y]

hook._doc: the first overlay must start at 0 and name the talent or the payoff
